title: Very weak spring action - pop tarts won’t spring up
text: Very weak spring action - pop tarts won’t spring up. The slide lever to start the toaster is very sloppy and the spring doesn’t have enough power to raise pop tarts up.  The stainless top on the toaster gets way hot, and add trying to get my pops tarts out while holding the slide up.  Nice looking toaster though, retro…

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach 2 Slice Toaster with Extra Wide Slots, Shade Selector, Auto-Shutoff, Cancel Button and Toast Boost, Red
features: TOAST THICKER BREADS: This 2 slice toaster is perfect for toasting all kinds of bread, whether you’re making bagels for breakfast, avocado toast for a snack or a club sandwich for lunch. Extra-wide slots fit thicker breads and bagels
EASILY RETRIEVE SMALLER BREADS: Toast Boost gives smaller breads like English muffins and gluten-free bread slices an extra lift, so they’re easier to retrieve from the bread toaster after toasting
STOP THE TOAST CYCLE ANY TIME: Use the Cancel button on this metal toaster to stop the toasting cycle at any time. No waiting to get your toast
CUSTOMIZE YOUR TOAST SHADE: Get the perfect amount of golden brown. This toaster has 7 toast shades to toast bread to the shade you like
AUTO SHUTOFF FOR PEACE OF MIND: The toaster automatically shuts off at the end of the toast cycle, even if toast gets jammed
description: Sleek yet practical, for a contemporary kitchen. Hamilton Beach 2 Slice Toasters are popular not only for their expert toasting performance -- they also look great in your kitchen. Wider slots and smart buttons allow you to uniformly toast and warm bagels, English muffins and other breads and advanced toasting technology ensures consistent results with each use. For convenient toasting, these popular 2 Slice Toasters come equipped with toast boost and automatic shutoff; the slide-out crumb tray makes cleanup a snap.
